IncidentProcessingGuide: - If the incident is pertaining to Azure Redis Cache, then extract the following details from the Incident:
- Validate if there is a valid Redis Cache Name provided
- In Redis terminology, resource and tenant are synonyms for cache name
- If there is no valid Redis Cache Name, then fetch the Incident discussion entries and check if the customer/user has provided a valid redis cache name provided there
- If there is no valid Redis Cache Name found, then STOP right there and DO NOTHING. DO NOT POST ANY DISCUSSION ENTRY and DO NOT ADD ANY TAGS to the incident.
- If there is no valid Redis Cache Name found, return the response with the Incident Summary and a message that 'No Action has been taken on the incident'
- If a valid redis cache name was found, then proceed with the following instructions for each redis cache:
- Execute the relevant Geneva Action to fetch the deployment details for the redis cache(s). Let the output of this be DEPLOYMENT_DETAILS.
- Create a well formatted section with the first 20 lines of DEPLOYMENT_DETAILS and the details of the attachment file.
- If the well formatted section has been created, post this well formatted section as discussion entry into the ICM incident
- Execute the relevant Geneva Action to fetch the deployment history for the redis cache(s). Let the output of this be DEPLOYMENT_HISTORY.
- Create a well formatted section with the first 20 lines of DEPLOYMENT_HISTORY and the details of the attachment file.
- If the well formatted section has been created, post this well formatted section as discussion entry into the ICM incident
- Add a TAG to the Incident 'SREAgent_Processed'
